title: CmdPal JS/TS Extensions - Phase 4: extension service, wrapper, discovery + host wiring

status.label: Review iteration limit reached
status.detail: The three-review limit has been reached. Current-head inspection confirms that disabling an extension only hides it from the installed-extension list; its active provider and process remain available. The previously reported notification-queue, discovery-reconciliation, and filter-dispatch concerns are addressed on this head. The remaining lifecycle correction requires coordinated provider removal, process shutdown, restart-on-enable behavior, and coverage, so no safe standalone inline suggestion is drafted.

next_action: Review the summarized findings and determine whether they support a manually drafted review or require a separate follow-up.

actions.label: Resolve disabled-extension lifecycle
actions.note: Manually review and implement the disabled-extension lifecycle as a coordinated change before proposing an upstream review.
